@willflach independent of bringing this to xDrip:
The upcoming version of NSClient as trimmed down version of AndroidAPS will have a quite extensive visualization of closed loop data from Nightscout on Android Phones and Android-Wear watches.
It also tracks battery and cannula age and is a quick native Android frontent for the Care-Portal what will give you a more or less automatic diary/reports if used.

For the 640g with it's limited loop capabilities it might be a bit of an overkill, but if you want to try, I can pass you an apk (without the active looping component controlling the Dana pump).
(The official release might take a while as the active looping component for the Dana Pump still has some issues in the developer version. The NSClient component is ready though, imho)

Liebe Grüße, Adrian

@jamorham 
Adding the information if the pump is suspended isn't sent via the broadcasts atm.
The broadcasts get their data from PumpStatusEvents: 
https://github.com/pazaan/600SeriesAndroidUploader/blob/master/app/src/main/java/info/nightscout/android/xdrip_plus/XDripPlusUploadIntentService.java#L116

Those PumpStatusEvents should already contain the information whether the pump is suspended or not:
https://github.com/pazaan/600SeriesAndroidUploader/blob/master/app/src/main/java/info/nightscout/android/model/medtronicNg/PumpStatusEvent.java#L150
or:
https://github.com/pazaan/600SeriesAndroidUploader/blob/master/app/src/main/java/info/nightscout/android/model/medtronicNg/PumpStatusEvent.java#L254

... and could be added to the json object broadcast through to xDrip and AAPS. To me this looks like just one/two loc.

@maxhofmanngithub You should just be able to select `Check for Update` from the 3 dot ... menu on the top right of the home screen of xDrip. If that doesn't work go in to Settings and change the update channel to `Nightly` if you don't see `Nightly` first choose `Alpha` and then go back in to settings and `Nightly` should appear. You should not need to uninstall anything.
Jon, the active insulin would only be important for therapy decision by telephone. But I am so very happy. Many Thanks. The very exact insulin has then the pump in the BolusExpert.
